widgetTool.name: show_payment_receipt_card
widgetTool.description: Shows a payment receipt card on chat after a successful payment: amount, date, confirmation number and the last 4 digits of the method. Use it after process_payment_cc or process_payment_ach when the caller is on chat; on voice, say the confirmation in short sentences. Values come only from the payment tool. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-payment-receipt-card and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-payment-receipt-card (the card element this tool renders).

confirmation.description: Confirmation number from the payment tool.

method_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card or bank account; never a full number.

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Say the amount and the confirmation number in one short sentence, and mention any convenience fee only when it is above zero.
